violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The shelves by the pizza oven, the sides and top of the pizza oven need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood system for the pizza oven needs to be cleaned.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of plastic wing tray containers were stored on the floor by the back reach in freezer.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The wall by the three compartment sink and behind the mixer needs to be cleaned. The floor by the door in the walk in cooler and behind the mixer need to be cleaned. The vents above the pizza cutting station need to be cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Larger holes in the wall above the pizza cutting station.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Inside 4 door prep cooler needs cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Shelving and racks in walk in cooler need cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors and walls need more thorough cleaning.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -Wet mop sitting in dirty water not in use.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean the shelving for clean dish storage.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean shelving in walk in cooler. -Clean lower shelving in pizza prep area. -Clean storage racks for pizza boxes and racks for pizza sauce storage. -Clean pizza dough racks in walk in cooler. -Clean handles and fronts of hot hold boxes.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Clean floors in walk in cooler.
